snippet.title: Jack Pottwin: House of Odds - Gameplay Trailer (Roguelike Deckbuilder)
snippet.description:
Jack Pottwin is a high-stakes Roguelike Deckbuilder where poker meets strategy. If you love the challenge of games like Balatro or Slay the Spire, check out the House of Odds. New Roguelike Deckbuilder 2026.


Fight your way up a 10-story casino tower to wake from a fever dream in this Roguelike Deckbuilder. Craft your deck, modify runs with lucky coins, and control the Odds. Fuse cards to build high value attacks, trigger poker combos to add powerful combat traits to your cards.

You will need to learn the rules and modify the odds of this rigged house and adapt as you progress through a 10-story tower fever dream, challenging a grotesque cast of  bosses that are human addicts fused directly into the casino hardware.

Fusions & Poker Combos: Fusing cards adds their values to create higher valued cards like Jack, Queen and King, while fusing Poker Hands adds traits like Lifesteal and Stun to the resulting card.

Forge Reel: Spin the reels before every encounter to choose and lock in your three starting  cards.

Lucky Coins: Equip coins that rewrite the rules of your run, granting passive benefits like shield carryover, bonus tickets or altering other game systems.

Contracts: Choose your next contract after defeating a boss to shape your progression and control the Odds.

Death Legacy: Carry over 3 cards, get a random lucky coin or keep the Tickets from a failed run to jumpstart your next attempt.


Three Card Actions:
Left: Store a card in your Vault to set up future fusions.

Right: Fuse your hand card with your Vaulted cards. Fusing merges their values to create Jack, Queen, and King cards, and fusing Poker Hands adds powerful combat traits.

Up: Attack enemies, letting overkill damage carry over to the next target and trigger accumulated card traits.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/4749530/
